recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抽吸抹片中，在分散的造血細胞之間出現一團緻密、互相黏著、深紫色的細胞聚團，與周圍單個分布的骨髓細胞明顯不同，這種非造血性黏著細胞團提示轉移性腫瘤（神經母細胞瘤）。
features: Single dense, cohesive three-dimensional cluster of darkly staining cells in the center
Clustered cells appear small to intermediate with high N:C ratio and nuclear crowding
Background of dispersed, heterogeneous hematopoietic cells including maturing granulocytes
Detailed nuclear morphology cannot be resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with dispersed, heterogeneous maturing hematopoietic cells. Centrally, there is a tight, cohesive three-dimensional cluster of small to intermediate-sized cells with high N:C ratios and nuclear crowding, distinct from the surrounding dispersed marrow cells. Nuclear detail and the presence of neuropil or rosettes cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a metastatic tumor cluster, consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: A particle contains mixed hematopoietic cells and fat, and a megakaryocyte is a single large cell, whereas this cluster is a monotonous cohesive aggregate.
Osteoblasts form loose groups of larger cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a paranuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Other metastatic small round cell tumors
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma and small cell carcinoma form similar clusters and require immunophenotyping to separate.
